title: IMPLEMENT Modular Monolith Architecture DDD and Zod DTO Validation Middleware
content:
**What**: Structured backend under domain modules (`src/modules/` for `productos`, `clientes`, `facturas`, `configuracion`), created strict separation (Controller -> Service -> Repository), and integrated Zod DTO validation middleware.
**Why**: Establishes enterprise-grade 2026 clean architecture, decoupling business logic from routing while ensuring payload type safety and validation coercion.
**Where**: `src/modules/`, `src/shared/middleware/validate.ts`, `src/app.ts`.
**Learned**: Using `z.coerce.number()` in Zod DTOs seamlessly bridges string form inputs from React/Astro islands with strict TypeScript numbers without manual type conversion.
